title: OPRD-Imp: a dataset of experimentally observed impurities and side products in multi-step pharmaceutical syntheses
abstract: arXiv:2611.07488v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting reaction impurities is a critical yet persistently data-limited challenge in pharmaceutical process chemistry. While machine learning models for reaction outcome prediction have advanced rapidly, benchmarking their ability to predict impurities remains impractical due to the absence of curated, publicly accessible datasets. We present OPRD-Imp, a dataset of 229 organic reactions drawn from 62 publications in Organic Process Research & Development, each annotated with experimentally observed impurities and their mechanistic origins. A total of 784 impurity entries is provided, classified into four origin categories. Reactions are represented as reaction SMILES and impurities as individual SMILES strings, with multi-step synthetic route connectivity preserved. All data were manually extracted from the source publications by trained chemists following a standardized extraction protocol, with expert chemical validation and manua

translated_title: OPRD-Imp：多步药物合成中实验观察到的杂质与副产物数据集
translated_abstract: 预测反应杂质是药物工艺化学中一个关键但长期受数据限制的挑战。尽管用于反应结果预测的机器学习模型发展迅速，但由于缺乏经过整理且可公开访问的数据集，对这些模型杂质预测能力进行基准测试仍难以实现。我们提出了OPRD-Imp数据集，该数据集包含来自《Organic Process Research & Development》期刊62篇出版物的229个有机反应，每个反应均标注了实验观察到的杂质及其机理来源。数据集共提供784条杂质条目，并按来源分为四个类别。反应以反应SMILES格式表示，杂质以单独的SMILES字符串表示，同时保留了多步合成路线的连接性。所有数据均由经过培训的化学家按照标准化提取协议从原始出版物中手动提取，并经过专家化学验证和人工审核。
tldr: 该论文构建了首个公开的多步药物合成杂质数据集OPRD-Imp，包含229个反应和784条经专家验证的杂质条目，为机器学习杂质预测模型的基准测试提供了关键数据资源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents OPRD-Imp, the first publicly available dataset of 229 multi-step pharmaceutical synthesis reactions annotated with 784 expert-validated impurity entries, providing a critical data resource for benchmarking machine learning models in impurity prediction.
